blurb: Guests fish from a 36' Contender boat with all bait, tackle, fuel, and fish cleaning included. Trips range from 1 hour dolphin or sunset tours to 12 hour deep sea charters. The captain decides on trip safety and may refund unused time if ended early due to weather.
